note: Chippewa NF campground on Little Cut Foot Sioux Lake off Hwy 46 (Avenue of the Pines Scenic Byway), 18 mi NW of Deer River, in birch and red pine. Accessible fishing dock, a fishing pier with a few boat slips, a fish-cleaning building, and a half-mile trail to the Cut Foot Sioux Visitor Center. --Claude
